tasks.title: Lecture #39
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a biology class.
tasks.transcript: In the early 1900s, sea otters, marine mammals that feed on invertebrates including sea urchins, were nearly wiped out along the United States Pacific Coast by fur hunters. With otters gone, urchin numbers exploded, destroying kelp forests. That kelp is a type of seaweed and it's sea urchins favorite food. This left countless marine species without the protective habitat that kelp forest provided to them. In 1972, hunting sea otters was banned. As otters made a comeback, urchin numbers dropped, kelp forest grew back, and biodiversity flourished. Scientists realized otters were a keystone species, organisms whose impact on ecosystems is far greater than their numbers suggest. A similar case occurred in Yellowstone National Park. Wolves, the parks top predator, had been eradicated. Populations of elk, a deer like animal and a favorite prey for wolves, soared and their huge populations damaged local vegetation, including the Willow and Aspen trees for which the park had been famous. In the 1990s, wolves were reintroduced to the park to get the elk population under control. But the wolves didn't just cut elk numbers, they changed elk behavior. Afraid of being eaten by wolves, the elk avoided stream side areas where they're especially vulnerable. This helped Willow and Aspen trees reestablish themselves there, and the trees brought back Beavers, animals that live in streams and build dams to create ponds for themselves. The Beaver dams created habitats for fish, birds and amphibians, a huge cascading effect because of this other keystone species.

questions.stem: What was the cause for the near disappearance of sea otters from waters along the United States Pacific coast?
questions.analysis: 答案: B 题目问的是: 美国太平洋海岸海獺几乎消失的原因是什么？ 定位原文: “Sea otters were nearly wiped out along the United States Pacific Coast by fur hunters.” 选项分析: A. “Disease.”（疾病。）并没有提到疾病，原文提到的是人为的过度捕猎，因此A选项错误。 B. “Overhunting by humans.”（人为的过度捕猎。）原文明确说明了海獺几乎因毛皮猎人的过度捕猎而几乎消失，因此B选项正确。 C. “Competition from other species.”（其他物种的竞争。）并没有提到这种竞争，原文提到的是人为捕猎的问题，因此C选项错误。 D. “Habitat destruction.”（栖息地破坏。）虽然栖息地的改变对海獺的生存有影响，但问题的核心是过度捕猎，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what happened to kelp forests when sea otters almost disappeared?

options.A: They became overgrown and crowded out other marine life.
options.B: They returned to their original size.
options.C: They were destroyed by expanding populations of sea urchins.
options.D: They began to attract species that the otters had previously preyed on

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 根据演讲者的说法，海獺几乎消失时，海藻森林发生了什么变化？ 定位原文: “Urchin numbers exploded, destroying kelp forests.” 选项分析: A. “They became overgrown and crowded out other marine life.”（它们过度生长，挤压了其他海洋生物。）并没有提到海藻过度生长的问题，因此A选项错误。 B. “They returned to their original size.”（它们恢复到原来的大小。）并没有恢复，海藻森林被摧毁了，因此B选项错误。 C. “They were destroyed by expanding populations of sea urchins.”（它们被海胆数量的激增摧毁。）原文确实提到海藻森林被海胆的数量暴增摧毁，因此C选项正确。 D. “They began to attract species that the otters had previously preyed on.”（它们开始吸引海獺之前捕食的物种。）并没有提到吸引其他物种的问题，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: How did elk behavior change after wolves were reintroduced to Yellowstone National Park?

options.A: Elk began to be more active at night
options.B: Elk began to form larger groups.
options.C: Elk began to feed less near streams
options.D: Elk began to hide among willow and aspen trees.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 在狼重新引入黄石公园后，麋鹿的行为发生了什么变化？ 定位原文: “Afraid of being eaten by wolves, the elk avoided stream side areas where they're especially vulnerable.” 选项分析: A. “Elk began to be more active at night.”（麋鹿开始在晚上更活跃。）原文并没有提到麋鹿的夜间活动，因此A选项错误。 B. “Elk began to form larger groups.”（麋鹿开始组成更大的群体。）并没有提到群体大小的变化，因此B选项错误。 C. “Elk began to feed less near streams.”（麋鹿开始减少在溪流附近觅食。）由于害怕狼，麋鹿避免了在溪流旁边活动，因此C选项正确。 D. “Elk began to hide among willow and aspen trees.”（麋鹿开始藏在柳树和白杨树中。）虽然树木恢复了，但原文没有提到麋鹿藏在树中的情况，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker emphasize about beavers in Yellowstone?

options.A: Their presence benefits many other animal species.
options.B: They are often preyed on by wolves.
options.D: They compete with elk for food.

questions.analysis: 答案: A 题目问的是: 演讲者强调了黄石公园中海狸的什么特性？ 定位原文: “The Beaver dams created habitats for fish, birds and amphibians, a huge cascading effect because of this other keystone species.” 选项分析: A. “Their presence benefits many other animal species.”（它们的存在惠及许多其他动物物种。）海狸通过筑坝为鱼类、鸟类和两栖动物提供栖息地，原文明确强调了海狸对其他物种的益处，因此A选项正确。 B. “They are often preyed on by wolves.”（它们经常被狼捕食。）并没有提到狼捕食海狸的问题，因此B选项错误。 C. “They often damage vegetation.”（它们经常破坏植物。）海狸通过其筑坝行为帮助恢复了树木，因此C选项错误。 D. “They compete with elk for food.”（它们与麋鹿争夺食物。）并没有提到海狸与麋鹿的食物竞争问题，因此D选项错误。
